Who actually places the order most often
Almost always the marina service manager or the mechanic working the boat. Boat owners rarely call us directly, maybe one order in ten.
When an urgent same-day call comes in
Whoever picks up writes it on the pad and puts a red star on it, then walks it to Marcus. If Marcus is out back it can sit for half an hour before a driver hears about it.
